extracted.intended_audience: general readers, podcast listeners, fans of Pete Holmes and comedy podcasts
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia article providing descriptive and technical information about the comedy interview podcast 'You Made It Weird with Pete Holmes', including format, production, notable guests, and distribution history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The show covers topics such as comedy, religion, and sexuality; while initially focusing on interviews with comedians, guests from other fields have increasingly appeared (musicians, pastors, scientists, authors).

rubrics_metrics.name: Host
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pete Holmes conducts interviews; producer Katie Levine is noted. The host-driven nature shapes interview style and topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format / Premise
rubrics_metrics.description: Originally the premise was that Holmes would ask his guest about three 'weird' things he knew about them; has since evolved into looser conversations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typical format is an interview with one guest discussing personal and comedic topics; the premise evolved from a fixed gimmick (three 'weird' things) to broader, in-depth conversations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Episode length
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard episode runtime is roughly two hours, indicating long-form conversational interviews rather than short segments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update frequency
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Episodes are released on a weekly schedule; the spin-off 'We Made It Weird' airs on Fridays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio format
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical specification for distribution; relevant for production and compatibility with podcast platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recording location and live episodes
rubrics_metrics.description: Usually recorded in-studio at the Nerdist studio at Meltdown Comics in Los Angeles; since March 21, 2012, multiple live episodes have been recorded at festivals and in various cities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Live episodes have featured several guests rather than the usual one and tend to focus more on comedy instead of the in-depth discussion of regular episodes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guest selection and topics
rubrics_metrics.description: Guests are usually fellow comedians but also include musicians, pastors, scientists, and authors; conversations cover comedy, religion, sexuality and personal stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notable guests and recurring guest types inform the show's tone and audience expectations; diversification of guest backgrounds expands topic range.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution / network history
rubrics_metrics.description: Hosted on the Nerdist network since October 25, 2011; as of August 2022 it is independently distributed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distribution history affects production, reach, and possibly editorial control; network affiliation changed over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spin-off variant
rubrics_metrics.description: We Made It Weird is a spin-off consisting solely of Holmes and his wife, Valerie, on every episode.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The spin-off retains a similar format and topics but with consistent, recurring hosts and a more intimate 'weekly catch-up' style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of episodes (metadata)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Episode count gives a sense of longevity and catalog size; relevant for archive, discovery, and longitudinal audience engagement.
